transcript.text: Just had a new induction hob fitted, Beko. When I put my saucepan on it just flashes a U and doesn't heat. Is it faulty? It's brand new!!

U on your Beko means: Pan not detected / unsuitable cookware (display shows U on induction models). This sounds like normal behaviour rather than a fault: Induction zones only heat magnetic pans of the right size. A flashing pan symbol (often 'U' or a pan icon) means no suitable pan is detected. A magnet sticking firmly to the pan base shows it is induction-compatible. It would be worth a closer look if a known induction-compatible pan of the right size is not detected on any zone. Now try switching a zone on. Is it working now, or still not?
Still not working with my saucepans, it just keeps flashing the U! A fridge magnet doesn't stick to them though. It does stick to my cast-iron casserole and that heated fine. So is the hob ok?

Yes, from what you've described the hob looks fine: the cast-iron casserole heated normally, which shows the zone is working. The flashing U simply means it isn't detecting a pan it can use, and since your saucepans aren't magnetic, an induction hob can't heat them. Then no repair is needed. If it ever does it in a way that does not fit that, get back in touch and we will look further.
